❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How accurate is the writing extraction?
A: Our converter achieves over 98% accuracy on clear images using OCR optical character recognition. Results may vary with img quality.

Q: Can I extract writing from screenshots?
A: Yes! Our converter excels at screenshot conversion. Simply capture your screen and click the OCR button.

Q: What languages are supported by Image to Text Converter?
A: The image to txt converter supports extraction in over 100 languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, and Japanese.

Q: Does it work offline?
A: While online OCR performs optimally, we offer basic offline functionality to get text from image when needed.

Q: Can I convert with batches?
A: No, our app does not support batch processing.

Q: How do I copy the extracted writing?
A: Use one click with our text extractor from image, or enable automatic clipboard copy in settings.

Q: Is my data secure?
A: We prioritize your privacy. Images are processed securely when you retrieve text from image, with no data stored without permission.
